Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Will you be attending the 2013 European Continental Championship that will be held the 4th-6th of October in Stockholm, Sweden?

Will you do more than 'Like' it on Facebook and attend or attend and bring other players with you?

www.facebook.com/EuropeanChampionship2013

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
There will most likely be a good contingent of Finnish players arriving via the infamous ferry lines departing from Turku and Helsinki. There will most likely be some VTES and certainly vast amounts of cheap booze (by Finnish and Swedish standards at least) involved. It is also possible to join this epic cruise, even if you fly first to Stockholm.

Oh, and in addition of trying to talk the Helsinki people join us to Turku ferry, I'm considering the option of organizing a tournament during this 11 hour long cruise.

Jussi Hattara

That's an awfully negative attitude for a volunteer.

There is already a volunteer list, and as long as the list of positive responses for attendance is smaller than that list, the organization knows that it can improve.

The poll is only interested in attendance, it isn't interested in those who can't / don't / won't find the time / money / vacation to make it to the event.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Currently, they can expect 23 players to attend.
Since the number of players responding to the poll will not change the date or location of the event, negative responses need not be tracked.

Perhaps something like:
"I am the volunteer from city Xxx and we will bring 10 players and win all the finals" would be more useful.
